title: Speak About Your Work
description: Learn to explain your job, daily responsibilities, colleagues and workplace routines in clear, simple English.

body_markdown:
## 1. Introduce your work

Use these sentence patterns:

- I work as a ______.
- I work at a ______.
- My duty starts at ______.
- I report to my supervisor.
- I work with a team.

Choose words that accurately describe your job.

## 2. Describe responsibilities

Useful verbs include check, manage, guide, assist, prepare, maintain, report and coordinate.

Examples:

- I check the daily records.
- I assist customers.
- I guide visitors.
- I prepare a daily report.
- I coordinate with my team.
- I report important issues to my supervisor.

## 3. Sample answer: What do you do?

“I work as a supervisor. I coordinate with the team and check daily operations. I help solve routine problems and report important matters to the manager. I believe communication and teamwork are important in my job.”

This is only a sample. Replace the role and duties with your real experience.

## 4. Common workplace questions

**What are your responsibilities?** — “My responsibilities include ______.”

**Who do you work with?** — “I work with ______.”

**What time do you start work?** — “I start work at ______.”

**What do you like about your job?** — “I like ______ because ______.”

## 5. Practice

Complete these sentences:

1. I work as a ______.
2. My main responsibility is ______.
3. I work with ______.
4. I report to ______.
5. I start work at ______.

## 6. Speaking task

Speak for one minute about your job. Include your role, two responsibilities, your team and one thing you have learned at work.

faq.question: How do I explain my job in English?
faq.answer: State your role, workplace and two or three main responsibilities using simple sentences.

faq.question: Which verbs are useful at work?
faq.answer: Common verbs include check, assist, prepare, maintain, coordinate, guide and report.

faq.question: What if I do not know a technical English word?
faq.answer: Explain the task in simpler words or describe what the item or process does.
